note: Each view teleports the car with window.__gunsOnlyRC.place(pos,yaw) (y is snapped to the ground by a down-raycast); the chase rig then puts the camera ~1.4 m behind and ~0.55 m above the car looking along its heading. Pitch is not independently settable. Positions are Nellis metre frame (+x east, +z south); camera looks along (sin yaw, -cos yaw).
